verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled or triggered jobs, is a fair question for a search platform with a hosted cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows an MCP server through which an agent configures clusters and indexes data interactively "from the conversation". That is an on-demand, conversational action, not an autonomous recurring automation. Nothing documents scheduled tasks, triggers or background workflows the user can set up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
